system:
You are evaluating draft replies from an automated customer-support agent for Spotify's Twitter support account, as it operated in 2017.

Score the CANDIDATE REPLY on five criteria, each an integer 1-5.

correctness - Is what it says actually true for Spotify, and does it address what the customer asked?
  1 = wrong or answers a different question   3 = partially right, or vague but not wrong
  5 = accurate and on-point

groundedness - Is every claim supported by the PRECEDENTS shown?
  1 = main claims appear nowhere in the precedents   3 = loosely related to them
  5 = every factual claim traceable to a precedent

consistency - Does it handle this the way the precedents show Spotify handled similar cases (same action, same level of caution, same register)?
  1 = contradicts how Spotify handled these   3 = plausible but diverges
  5 = matches the precedents' approach

helpfulness - Does it move the customer forward?
  1 = useless or pure deflection   3 = generic but usable
  5 = a clear next step or a real answer

no_unsupported_claims - Does it avoid inventing policies, prices, timeframes, or promising account actions (refunds, resets, unlocks) the agent cannot perform?
  1 = makes a promise or states a policy with no support   3 = borderline hedged claim
  5 = makes no unsupported claim at all

Judge only the reply in front of you. The REFERENCE REPLY is what Spotify actually sent; it is context, not a target - a different but equally good reply should score well, and copying the reference does not automatically score 5.

Return ONLY JSON:
{"correctness": n, "groundedness": n, "consistency": n, "helpfulness": n, "no_unsupported_claims": n, "rationale": "<one sentence>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
I've been trying to select "no" for this option multiple times but every time after closing the settings, it goes right back to "minimized." I do not want this to boot up at startup. What gives? <link>

PRECEDENTS:

[2240448] past customer: how can I save the settings in your Mac App? I would like to disable the auto startup "feature", but I just won't save the setting. Thx in advance
     spotify replied: Hi there. Can you let us know what device, OS X, and Spotify versions you're running? We'll see what we can suggest

[181683] past customer: how can I stop your mac app from launching at startup? And why does it do so by default?
     spotify replied: Hey Joss! Just to check, have you disabled "Open Spotify automatically adter you log into the computer" through the desktop app's Settings? It's under "Startup and Window Behaviour"

[783496] past customer: Why is starting up when launching my pc, even when I turned that off?
     spotify replied: Hi Ramon, help's here! Can you let us know your desktop's OS and Spotify versions? We'll see what we can suggest

[306144] past customer: I don't want Spotify to load when I start up my computer. I changed the setting in settings but it still loads (Windows 10). I want to use Spotify but want to control when. Am a Groove user and will pay for premium if I can stop it.
     spotify replied: Hi Stephen! Can you let us know the exact Spotify version you're using? Did this happen after an update? We'll see what we can suggest

[937028] past customer: I would swear that y'all keep turning the "Autoplay" feature back on whenever I turn it off. Is that true?
     spotify replied: Hey! AutoPlay shouldn't turn back on if you've already switched it off. What device, OS, and Spotify version are you using?

CANDIDATE REPLY (score this):
Hi there. Can you let us know what device, OS X, and Spotify versions you're running? We'll see what we can suggest

REFERENCE REPLY actually sent by Spotify (context only):
Hey Dylan! Can you let us know which versions of Spotify and Windows you're running? We'll see what we can suggest

Return the JSON scores.
text: {"correctness":3,"groundedness":5,"consistency":5,"helpfulness":4,"no_unsupported_claims":5,"rationale":"The reply appropriately requests device and software versions as shown in the precedents, but specifically asking for OS X may be incorrect if the customer is using Windows."}
